description: Result of the repro stage: one failing test that proves the issue.

reproduced.description: True when a test has been prepared for the harness to execute and check against the expected assertion. The harness, not the agent, decides whether it reproduces.

crate.description: Project the test belongs to, as the execution profile selects it: the Cargo package name (`cargo test -p`) for rust-cargo; an empty string for python-pytest.

test_file.description: Repository-relative path of the new test file, forward slashes (e.g. tests/issue_123.rs, src/parser/issue_123_tests.rs or tests/test_issue_123.py).

test_name.description: The exact test identity the runner prints: for rust-cargo the bare function name of an integration test or the module path of a unit-test module (e.g. parser::issue_123_tests::issue_123_rejects_short_frame); for python-pytest the node id (e.g. tests/test_issue_123.py::test_issue_123_rejects_short_frame).

command.description: The command that runs exactly this test, as the prompt describes it. Informational: the harness rebuilds it from the execution profile.

expected.description: Short verbatim substring of the failing output that proves the bug (assertion message or panic text). No paths, line numbers or timings. Must be non-empty when reproduced is true.

observed.description: What actually happened when the command was run (key output lines).

registration_file.description: For a rust-cargo unit-test module: the existing source file that received the `#[cfg(test)] mod issue_<n>_tests;` line. Null for an integration test and for profiles without registration (python-pytest).

notes.description: What the fixer should know; when reproduced is false, why the issue could not be reproduced.
